metrics.reporting_rule: Report each metric separately for each model, direction, and test set. Do not average General Test and IT Test.

normalization.input: Use released text exactly; do not apply corpus-cleaning rules after the release is frozen.
normalization.output: Score raw model text after removing only framework-added special tokens and surrounding whitespace.

inference.model_revision: pin immutable revision or commit SHA
inference.generation_overrides: No model-specific quality tuning beyond mandatory language-code settings.

benchmark.device: record OS, CPU, GPU, RAM, runtime and precision
benchmark.latency_unit: milliseconds per sentence; report median and p95
benchmark.ram: peak process RSS during inference, recorded separately per model/direction/test set
benchmark.model_size: serialized artifact bytes and parameter count where available

selection_policy: Teacher/student or adaptation candidates may be selected only from the complete, frozen comparison table.
